pageTitle: Klacks for Hospitality & Food Service in Ireland | Shift Schedules, Premiums & Rest Periods

hero.titleHtml: Early, late, night shifts — scheduled fairly.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules front of house, kitchen, and housekeeping in Ireland — with split shifts, Sunday and public-holiday premiums, and statutory rest periods, with Klacks warning when they are not met. The planning helps absorb seasonal peaks and absences.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks timeline view for shift schedules in hospitality and food service in Ireland

items.title: Split shifts
items.text: Lunch and dinner service with a break in between: split shifts are the norm in Ireland's hotels, pubs, and restaurants — and they raise rest-period and premium questions that are nearly impossible to plan cleanly by hand.

items.title: Season & hourly wages
items.text: Seasonal peaks, temporary staff, and changing availability: the staffing mix shifts weekly, yet the schedule still has to be right.

items.title: Nights, Sundays & holidays
items.text: Business peaks exactly when everyone else is off — reconciling premiums, rest periods, and Sundays off is the real art of scheduling.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for hospitality
solutions.subtitle: From the early shift to the night shift — it all works together.

items.title: Split shifts planned cleanly
items.text: Klacks schedules lunch and dinner blocks and checks minimum rest periods and daily maximum hours in the process — every shortfall is flagged immediately.

items.title: Rest periods in view
items.text: Statutory rest-period limits that you set up are monitored in real time — violations are flagged immediately. On request, Klacks blocks them in block mode in the automatic planning paths (e.g. wizard, suggestions, substitution); in manual planning, Klacks warns.

items.title: Premiums as time credits
items.text: Klacks credits night, Sunday, and public-holiday premiums as time credits in hours — configurable per country and rule set, as an hours basis for your payroll preparation.

items.title: Qualifications & certifications
items.text: Shifts are only filled by staff with the right qualification — Klacks warns about expiring certifications before they become a problem.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: “Schedule the weekend, two servers are out sick” is enough — Klacksy starts the replanning.

items.title: Absences covered fast
items.text: If someone drops out, Klacks immediately shows who's qualified, available, and within rest-period and maximum-working-time limits.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your operation
cta.text: Try it in the Playground and see how Klacks handles shift schedules, premiums, and rest periods — or install it directly on your own infrastructure. No license fees, no registration required.
